amendment.reason: V4 completed its formal court after a concurrent spatial-regularization edit changed the live package candidate. The analyzer failed closed during provenance validation, before reading statistical outputs. V4 and every materialized file are retained and hash-bound as inadmissible history rather than rerun or mutated.
amendment.protocol_change: Bind the unchanged certification design to the newly frozen package candidate and correct the court output-directory version label from v4 to v5.
amendment.inherited_numerical_amendment: The sole numerical amendment remains v3's fixed Sinkhorn max_iter ceiling of 50000, inherited from v2's invalidated ceiling of 5000. The marginal tolerance remains 0.0001.
amendment.candidate_change_before_results: V5 binds the retained spatial-regularization diagnostics and their strict estimator-identity validation after focused source tests passed and the candidate source tree stabilized. These edits change neither the frozen court helper nor any design constant, arm, estimand, gate, seed, sign action, or stopping rule.
amendment.unchanged: Epsilon values, marginal tolerance, 50000 iteration ceiling, seeds, grid, arms, estimands, sign actions, statistical gates, and stopping rules are byte-for-byte inherited from v3.
amendment.no_second_numerical_amendment: V5 makes no numerical or statistical protocol amendment. Any remaining numerical failure invalidates v5; the iteration ceiling will not be raised again.

candidate_contract.reference_self_map: Every subject, including the selected reference, is fitted with the same entropic mapper and fixed epsilon policy.
candidate_contract.independent_features: Recommended correspondence channel, but the current rank-truncated contrast estimator retains same-data latent-span dependence and is therefore approximate.
candidate_contract.same_data_residualized: Conditional covariance residualization is an approximate fallback, never an exact frozen-plan test under rank truncation.
candidate_contract.geometry_only: Ancillary alignment bound; it does not demonstrate functional correspondence.
candidate_contract.full_reestimation: Exact comparator only for the frozen raw sign action and simulated DGP scope.
candidate_contract.release_claim: Court failure blocks inferential promotion, not delivery of a fail-closed approximate workflow. Approximate inference requires an explicit override.

court.implementation: The v1 court implementation and OAT grid are reused without changing estimands, signs, seeds, arms, or gates; outputs are written to a source-tree-addressed v5 directory.

gates.exact_oracle: Every exact-oracle cell has a Wilson 95% interval containing 0.05 and convergence at least 0.95.
gates.negative_control_promotion: Geometry-only and independent-alignment cells each have a Wilson 95% interval containing 0.05, upper bound at most 0.12, and convergence at least 0.95.
gates.same_data: Always approximate even when observed size is favorable.

court.stopping_rule: Run all scheduled cells. Do not replace seeds, remove adverse cells, retune epsilon, or alter gates after observing results.

known_warp_power.statistic: Maximum absolute one-sample t over reference-support locations with all unique sign actions modulo global sign.
known_warp_power.power_role: Descriptive efficacy with Wilson uncertainty. No power superiority threshold can promote an arm or override court/provenance gates.
